name: iLovePDF Premium
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For ILovePDF Premium, merge, split, compress, convert, and annotate PDFs without uploading them to a vendor. The hard boundary is simple hosted delivery, mobile apps, desktop tools, ocr, and batch capacity, plus document fidelity, identity, and compliance.
